notes.title: Dev Update - Runes & Magic ✨
notes.content:

This is where you can outplay your friends by casting powerful runes to influence the vote.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/0028a02db6e9126103fa6875f406350cf8f6abde.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update - Battle Games ⚔️
notes.content:
Development on Frenemies continues with new immunity battle modes where the winner cannot be voted at the next sacrifice. Keep an eye out for these in the upcoming announcement trailer!

[b]💥 Hot Potato[/b]
One player is randomly given the hot potato and starts to burn. Shoot a new target to pass the potato before you explode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/63afd51daec373b53ef2929744faa3518046350b.png[/img]

[b]💰 Treasure Hunt[/b]
A race to collect all the treasure. Thinking about also adding a grappling hook attack to help catch up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/ae29eecaefffbeef170790047419def9bf1169c7.png[/img]

[b]👻 Don't Blink[/b]
The undead are frozen in place, just pray the lights don't go out because that's when they like to hunt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/c5c0c04e88bd8140af027d4b8255929146bf65cb.png[/img]

🎮 Wishlist & follow for more updates soon!

notes.title: Dev Update - The Undead ☠️
notes.content:
Frenemies development continues with new battle modes that place voted out players against the surviving players. Let's hope they aren't too bitter about being voted off 🔪😂.

The winner gets immunity from being the next sacrifice in the fight to be the last player standing.

Here's a brief look at some of the new minigames:

[b]🙈 Hide n Seek[/b]
Hide and run from the undead seekers for as long as possible. Seekers have a narrow field of vision so get your juking buttons ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/d0a80c241a68d1c931c09aa2da7fb1981498f732.png[/img]

[b]📦 Prop Hunt[/b]
Disguise yourself as a harmless object and hide out in the open! Sometimes the more obvious the spot the better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/48971891127414f5a0ab38ebc82e9b330dbc5468.png[/img]

[b]⚓ Pirate Heist[/b]
Fight for treasure and survival on the open seas! Assemble a crew and target other players but be careful because only one can be left standing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/21a0753e114ccd6afc5006e27f701cbaa3919aec.png[/img]

🎮 Wishlist & follow for more updates soon!

notes.title: Dev Update - New Minigames ⚔️
notes.content:
Frenemies dev is well underway with new battle modes coming soon!

Battling for Immunity is a big part of the game because the winner is granted immunity from being the next sacrifice in the fight to become the last player standing. This gives the winner of each battle temporary safety and power over the game as players will have to choose a different player to eliminate.

Here's a brief look at some of the new minigames:

[b]☣️ Infected[/b]
Survive as zombie players try to infect you. If you are infected join the hunt until 1 player remains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/af1a99582414f2f5a022488271613e0dae8d542d.png[/img]

[b]💎 Gold Rush[/b]
Each player will need to collect minerals and try be the first to push their minecart over the finish line. But be careful not to push it off the tracks as you might just have to start over!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/6637cf6593a90a25cb3bd336ed6030195e9d9045.png[/img]

[b]🐔 Capture the Chicken[/b]
Grab the chicken and hold on for dear life because trust me.. they're coming for you..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956281/432c0ef565db015eac16c9eb50f9929f27bc0736.png[/img]

🎮 Wishlist & follow for more updates soon!
